prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. ONE woman, facing the camera in a frontal view, framed from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Vietnamese woman, mid 20s, with a cozy teddy-bear heroine look brought to life, with short honey-brown hair in a soft bob with wispy bangs and two small round buns on top like bear ears. Her complexion is a warm light beige with a soft glow, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in warm caramel-brown contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long curled lashes, a soft brown and gold shimmer on the lids and a gentle wing liner, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, with the iris filling most of the eye opening, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are small and glossy, in a rose-pink gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, curved into a shy smile. A deep warm-pink blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A warm, shy, wide-eyed gaze with a hint of sweetness. Her skin, across her face, neck and shoulders, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders and collarbones, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead and collarbones, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands. Jewelry: on each ear, three separate heavy ear weights of real polished sterling silver hanging from a polished gold ring through the lobe, each on its own gold chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a round bell, a hammer head, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre; on the right ear a ship's anchor, a cube-shaped block, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim. Every weight is a dense, solid, heavy, bright, polished lump of sterling silver about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears a real chunky sterling silver cable-chain necklace resting on her collarbones. Pose: head tilted, one fingertip lightly touching her cheek.

Background: a softly blurred cozy bedroom with warm string-light bokeh.

Lighting: bright, soft, even light across the face with only gentle shading, and a thin rim light along the hair and shoulders. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/4, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
